name: book-to-wiki-graph
description: Convert books into TOC-centered organizer and link-free atom graphs with organization-first Obsidian Canvas files.

interface.shortDescription: Turn books into atomic Wiki graphs.
interface.longDescription: Convert a book PDF to Markdown, derive an open-depth organizer hierarchy from its table of contents, classify source-complete atoms, validate the corpus, and generate separate overview, chapter, and semantic Obsidian Canvas files.
defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF into a TOC-centered Wiki graph.
Audit this book graph's organizers and atoms.
Build organization-first Canvas files from this atomic book graph.
